name: Curtin Guild Food Pantry
summary: Free pantry staples for enrolled Curtin students in genuine financial hardship, by booking, up to twice a semester.
key: The Guild Food Pantry stocks a range of non-perishable pantry staples.
who: Available to currently enrolled Curtin University students facing genuine financial hardship
how: Book a time slot and bring your Curtin student card to Guild Building 106F (Tue, Wed, Fri)
catches: Up to two visits per semester
